def execute_command(image) -> List[ImagePatch]:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    people = image_patch.find("person")
    if not people: return image_patch
    
    sitting_people = [p for p in people if p.verify_property("person", "squatting")]
    if not sitting_people: return image_patch
    
    ground_patches = image_patch.find("ground")
    if not ground_patches: return image_patch
    
    ground_center = sum(g.vertical_center for g in ground_patches) / len(ground_patches)
    
    photo_takers = []
    for person in sitting_people:
        person_bottom = person.upper
        if person_bottom < ground_center:
            photo_takers.append(person)
    
    if not photo_takers: return image_patch
    
    photo_takers.sort(key=lambda p: p.horizontal_center)
    return photo_takers
